summary: Build reform roadmaps, scorecards, and service diagnostics for stronger public value. Book advanced training today.
lede: Public service reform focuses on improving institutional processes and the results people receive from public services. For senior and mid-career public professionals, this course develops practical ways to diagnose service gaps, prioritize reforms, map workflows with SIPOC, design performance scorecards, and plan implementation milestones under constraints such as limited budgets and uneven data.
audienceIntro: This course is built for senior and mid-career public sector professionals who need to improve reform execution and service delivery performance in complex institutional settings.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should have working knowledge of public administration, policy implementation, or service operations in a public institution. Familiarity with basic performance reporting, process improvement, or project coordination will help, but you do not need coding skills; digital and data-enabled topics are covered at operational application and conceptual awareness level where relevant. You should bring a laptop for workbook exercises, and if available, a current service plan, performance report, reform memo, or citizen service charter from your organization. Prior exposure to results-based management, process mapping, or public finance terminology will be useful, especially for the implementation and reporting exercises.
